units.source_text: 今夜匂亲王于夜色未深之时即赴六条院。

en.t: That night Prince Niou went to the Rokujo estate before the night had grown late.

units.source_text: 二女公子听见开路喝道之声渐渐远去，

en.t: The Second Princess heard the voices clearing the way gradually fade into the distance,
and felt only that her tears were more plentiful than those of the fishermen at the fishing shore,

units.source_text: 自己也讨厌自己的妒心。

en.t: and she herself hated her own jealousy.

units.source_text: 她躺卧着，一面思量，一面倾听。

en.t: She lay there, thinking while she listened.

units.source_text: 回想起匂亲王最初就使她苦恼的种种情状，

en.t: When she recalled all the ways Prince Niou had troubled her from the very beginning,
she felt at last that her regret was beyond remedy.

units.source_text: 她想：“此次怀孕，不知结局如何。

en.t: She thought, This pregnancy may end in I know not what way.

units.source_text: 自己一族人中多短命者，

en.t: Many people in my family have died young,

units.source_text: 此次我或许将死于难产，亦未可知。

en.t: and this time I too may die in difficult childbirth, for all I know.

units.source_text: 虽然性命无足轻重，但死去毕竟是可悲的。

en.t: Although life may not be worth much, death is still sorrowful.

units.source_text: 况且因产而死，罪孽深重……”

en.t: And to die because of childbirth would surely carry a heavy burden of sin.

units.source_text: 她左思右想，一夜不眠，直到天明。

en.t: She turned these thoughts over and over, unable to sleep all night until dawn.
